newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa hails China's Deng.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa hails China's Deng.

text.p: South Africa hailed Deng Xiaoping on Thursday as a great leader who guided China safely to the threshold of the 21st century.
"Deng Xiaoping's legacy will be remembered for generations," South Africa's Foreign Affairs Department said in a statement.

"(He) was one of the great leaders of the 20th century, whose bold step in opening China to the world and the introduction of economic reforms, laid the foundation for his country to enter the next century with confidence," the department said.
South Africa also extended condolences to the government and the Chinese people during their time of mourning, it said.
